title: eval-harness: add CI hook and gating for prompt-set regression and eval metrics
description:
Motivation: We need automated guarding against prompt-set regressions and metric-level quality drops on model changes and infra updates. This PR adds a GitHub Actions CI hook that runs a lightweight eval-harness job against a maintained baseline prompt-set and publishes pass/fail gating based on configurable metric thresholds.

What changed: added a new eval CI workflow, a reusable prompt-set baseline bundle, the CI hook implementation that computes eval metrics and posts a status to the PR, and documentation for configuring thresholds and writing new prompt-sets.

Checklist:
- [x] CI workflow: ci/workflows/eval-gate.yaml
- [x] Hook implementation: eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py
- [x] Baseline prompt-set and golden metrics: eval-harness/prompt-sets/baselines/faq_baseline.json and baseline_metrics.yaml
- [x] Integration tests: tests/integration/test_prompt_regression.py
- [x] Docs: docs/eval-harness/ci-gates.md

Behavior and policy: The hook runs on PRs touching models, runtime, or prompt-sets and on a scheduled nightly run. It computes configured metrics (exact-match, rouge-l, accuracy for classification prompts, delta on BLEU for translation style prompts) and compares them to stored baselines using absolute and relative thresholds. If any metric exceeds the configured regression threshold the GitHub check is marked failed and the PR is blocked by the status check. Thresholds are configurable via .github/eval-gate-config.yml and can be overridden per-repo via environment variables.

Testing: Local unit tests were added and integration tests run in CI. I ran the workflow on a fork and exercised both pass and fail outcomes (see CI checks). The initial CI run failed due to a flaky timing check; I adjusted the timeout and retriggered. All checks pass on merge.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the job lightweight (sampled prompt-set, short inference timeout) to keep latency in CI acceptable. We expect teams to opt into heavier nightly/regression pipelines if they want stricter coverage.

release_notes: Add CI gating for prompt-set regressions: introduces a lightweight eval-gate workflow, a prompt regression hook that computes eval metrics against baselines, and docs on configuring thresholds. This enables automated blocking of PRs with metric regressions.
